method:
Scored by Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5) in a Claude Code session on 2026-09-24, working as ten parallel sub-agents from one written brief. Each subject was scored against all 30 fields of the draft four-bucket workbook, with a justification per field.

Sources: the project inventory (lib/portfolio.ts and the governance, value, OIT-pathway, and OIT FY2027 EA modules), the request registry on the dev database as of 2026-09-24 (tech_requests with ClickUp v2 scores, OIT IDEA form rows and their machine-inferred fields, ROI claims, request-project links), the ClickUp project snapshot (last synced 2026-07-23), the request-registration migrations, and the hosted request documents. For project documentation and maintainer counts, some scorers also read the projects' public GitHub repositories and local clones. No owners or requestors were interviewed; nothing was verified with them.

Ten requests are the same work as a scored portfolio project (nine approved ClickUp intake requests and the PDF remediation request that became AccessForge). They are scored through the project, not twice.

Conventions: staff time converted to dollars at $75,000 per loaded FTE-year (about $36/hour) and IIDS developer time at $110,000 per loaded FTE-year (about $53/hour). Both are scorer conventions, not published University of Idaho rates; any figure resting on them is tagged Estimated or Assumed, never Observed. Campus-wide reach uses roughly 11,000 students and 2,800 faculty and staff. Where a source gave no basis, the field is recorded as unknown with the reason.

evaluations.summary: OpenERA is the only subject in this batch with a sizable named contract to retire: VERAS at $150,000/yr, renewing 2027-03-31, and OIT carries the replacement as a Critical FY27 item. The savings figure comes from the portfolio entry; build and maintenance costs are scorer placeholders, and the Net 5-Year sign depends on the maintenance assumption. The biggest unknown is whether an MVP plus the required dual-operation period can finish before the March 2027 renewal.

subject.title: VandalChat — campus-wide AI chat on MindRouter

evaluations.summary: A built chat front end for MindRouter, running on a beta host, with a dated two-phase scope of work and measured GPU capacity (one HGX B300 node sustains ~4,100 concurrent users). personnel_avoided_annual.justification: The request names no position that would go unfilled or unbackfilled.

status_quo_cost_eliminated_annual.justification: The request does not describe how payments are collected today or what that costs.

maintenance_cost_annual.justification: No recurring fee is stated.

savings_start_year.justification: No savings are claimed.
